overall_conclusion: All 5 scrips are confirmed absent from NSE under two independent data sources: (1) NSE EQ bhavcopy for 2018-06-15 (1,494 rows, real HTTP 200 fetch, log-verified), (2) NSE currently-listed equity symbol master (2,571 symbols, real HTTP 200 fetch). The 0-days-fetched result is NOT a code bug — these instruments are not NSE-listed. The specific claim 'confirmed BSE-only' is weaker: both NSE data sources are consistent with BSE-only listing, but no BSE scrip master lookup was performed to positively confirm BSE listing. The correct description is: 'confirmed not NSE-listed; BSE-only status is the most probable explanation but has not been independently verified against BSE data.'
